body.description: Doña Marta, a broad cheerful woman in her sixties who serves at the church: white hair braided in a crown, an orange flowered dress under a white apron, sleeves rolled, a big ladle in one hand, laughing face. a person of a small South Texas border town generations after the sky turned white, sun-faded patched clothes, dust on the boots
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
